thread:
sam: Quick sync 3: update on hero copy for hosted / dedicated / private pages. Need ultra-short variants for social cards + explicit CTA routing for webinar traffic. Keep hero <=10 words on social.

lina: Understood. Two goals: 1) social card headline (8-10 words) + 1-line subtitle; 2) page hero (10-14 words) + one supporting sentence. Also list CTA destinations per mode.

devin: I sketched 3 social headlines per mode and a fallback mapping. Posting here so we can iterate fast. :rocket:

rachel: Nice. Also remember legal: private page must link to our security brief PDF and show a short privacy snippet under CTA.

marketing-bot: Drafts uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/marketing/hero-mini-variants (view: team-marketing).

sam: Devin's social headlines:
Hosted A: "Start building with a fast hosted LLM API"
Hosted B: "Ship LLM features fast 1ms tail latency (typical)"
Hosted C (cost): "Lower inference bills as you scale usage"

Dedicated A: "Dedicated GPU pools for steady production traffic"
Dedicated B: "Predictable throughput, SLA-backed performance"
Dedicated C (ops): "Reserved capacity  predictable performance"

Private A: "Run inference inside your network or data center"
Private B: "On-prem or VPC deployments for regulated workloads"
Private C (security): "Full control, audit logs, and key management"

lina: Quick edits: remove raw numbers (like 1ms) from social headlines; keep them for page subcopy. Also change phrasing: Hosted B -> "Ship LLM features fast, no ops required".

devin: Got it. Updated list and added short subtitles for each (one-liners). Paste:
Hosted subtitle: "Hosted API, streaming responses, developer SDKs."
Dedicated subtitle: "Reserved GPU pools, autoscale options, SLA."
Private subtitle: "VPC/on-prem control, audit logs, KMS integration."

rachel: CTA mapping (final):
- Hosted CTA -> /signup?utm=hero_social (self-serve trial)
- Dedicated CTA -> /sales/enterprise?utm=hero_social (AE intro)
- Private CTA -> /sales/private?utm=hero_social (security packet + AE)
- Webinar CTA (from social) -> /demo?utm=webinar_social (demo queue + solutions.eng)
Include hidden form field campaign=hero_social_ab.

sam: Also propose A/B plan: Variant 1 (performance-led) vs Variant 2 (cost-led). Split 50/50 on social. Landing uses corresponding hero and subtitle. Run 14 days.

marketing-bot: Playbook snippet added: https://drive.redwood/playbooks/launch-routing-mini (edited by rachel).

devin: Example social post copy we can use with the card:
Post A: "Ship LLM features faster with Redwood1 Start a free trial or join our webinar to see benchmarks. #llm #inference"
Post B: "Reduce inference cost as you scale 1 See a live demo and cost comparison this Thursday. #aiops"

lina: For webinar landing: change CTA to "See performance in action" and add question checkbox "Request cost estimate" so SDRs can qualify.

rachel: Forms: add hidden tag source=social_card, campaign=hero_social_ab, variant=performance|cost. CRM mapping: webinar_demo -> assigned to Devin (solutions.eng), trial_signup -> auto-activate trial, enterprise_lead -> route to AE queue.

sam: Microcopy under Private CTA: "Data stays in your network  inputs are not stored by Redwood." Short and legal ok.

marketing-bot: Legal approved microcopy (ref: doc ID S-2026).

devin: I'll push two sets of page copy to staging: performance-led + cost-led. Lina will QA visual density for social cards.

lina: Also prepping short variants for webinar slide deck: one micro-benchmark chart (p95 latency vs tokens/sec) and one simple cost table (starter vs dedicated). Keeping visuals simple.

sam: Timeline: push copy to staging by Wed EOD, QA Thu, social go-live Fri morning, run 14 days, mid-run check next Monday.

marketing-bot: A/B experiment scheduled in Growth Console: experiment id ab-hero-2026, start Fri 09:00 UTC. Notifications will be posted to #marketing.

rachel: Thanks team. Final ask: include UTM examples in the copy doc so ops can validate routing. Example: /signup?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=hero_social_ab&utm_variant=performance

sam: Perfect. Closing the loop: we'll review performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, demo signups) in the Monday sync. :bar_chart:
